manifest.description: High-performance Web Search filter. Triggers: '?? <query>', '??' (context-aware), or local natural-language web/current-info requests.

changes: Added conservative Spanish/natural-language web-search intent detection.
Kept upstream ?? trigger behavior for explicit and context-aware searches.
Made ShadowRequest compatible with Open WebUI versions where request.app.state.config is not present.
Serialized EasySearch inlet/outlet execution to avoid shared-state races in multi-model comparison chats.
Expanded natural-language trigger detection for current sports/news/status questions such as lineups or live match status.
Recommended native Web Search bypass settings for EasySearch: bypass loader and embedding/retrieval, with DuckDuckGo result_count=8.
Patched Arena streaming error propagation so JSONResponse provider errors do not surface as missing body_iterator.
Always includes the user's original request as the first search query before optional LLM query expansion.
Skips LLM query expansion when the selected model is arena-model.
Detects sports schedule follow-ups such as 'cuando juega Colombia?', 'a que hora juega?', and 'proximo partido'.
Adds stronger web-context and verification instructions so models do not claim lack of internet or invent current facts when search results are present.
Runs EasySearch internal query-generation and context-extraction LLM calls with filters bypassed, restoring request state afterwards, to prevent deadlocks in normal and group chats.
Adds an internal re-entry guard so EasySearch returns immediately if an internal EasySearch helper call ever reaches the filter chain.
